title: a-voyage-names-its-ticket
owner: CC (code+proofs); Akien (the dated need is his plan
intention: THE JURISDICTION TIGHTENS — the unnamed-ticket bypass closes at both hands. Today the entry and exit gates fire only when the crossing's journal_extra names a CAST ticket; a voyage that omits the name crosses BUILDME and PROVED ungated (build_inspector charter edge (k): 'an unnamed ticket crosses ungated'). This stone lands the stricter rule the charter said 'waits for a dated need': a forward journaled crossing into BUILDME or PROVED must name a cast ticket, or it refuses — with the legitimate ticketless roster (whatever constrain establishes it to be) named explicitly in the code, never ambient.
why: The dated need arrived 2026-07-29 with the budget stage-split plan: builds delegated to cheaper-model agents with minimal context. The gates are the trust mechanism that makes delegation safe — but v0 jurisdiction is opt-in (name the ticket and be judged; omit it and slip through). A delegated builder is exactly the hand most likely to omit the name, innocently or not. Both gate stones filed this hole the day they landed; one tightening now covers both hands, because both share the same jurisdiction branch at the one chokepoint.
traces_to: Law 4 — the every-crossing-names-a-ticket rule moves from charter prose (edge (k)) into the chokepoint
Law 8 — a voyage that cannot show its ticket is a build entering proven-space without the chart a hollow build couldn't fake; the side door closes
Law 7 — the refusal is loud and complete first-pass; a legitimate ticketless crossing (if the roster admits any) journals WHY it is exempt, never passes silently
Law 1 — the ticket is the universal work unit already (/sorted); requiring its name re-derives nothing, it surfaces what casting already settled

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth beside the code — a forward BUILDME/PROVED crossing with no named cast ticket refuses before anything is written, naming what is missing and where casting lives (/sorted); the exempt roster (per constrain) passes gated-and-clean on the record, never silently; back-edges and non-BUILDME/PROVED crossings untouched; every existing green tooth in test_transitions still greens (the tightening breaks no proven crossing). Tester netns seal. Live gate: the sibling stones' own voyages cross under the tightened rule.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a forward BUILDME or PROVED crossing that names no cast ticket and passes without either refusing or journaling its explicit exemption; a named-but-uncast ticket treated as exempt rather than refused; the refusal firing on back-edges or mid-voyage crossings outside the two doors; an exemption granted ambiently (not from the explicit roster).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when a new workflow class (e.g. skill@v1 via skills-ride-the-chokepoint) adds crossings with a different ticket relationship; when maintenance/at-rest crossings surface a real exemption candidate; when the exit gate's verdict-multiplicity edge (b) is worked.
